name: Integer absolute value expression
prompt: Return exactly one expression in integer variable x that computes the absolute value of x for every integer. Allowed syntax: integer literals, x, +, -, *, parentheses, comparisons, and If(condition, then_value, else_value). Do not use division, functions other than If, prose, or Markdown.

name: Integer ReLU expression
prompt: Return exactly one expression in integer variable x that computes max(x, 0) for every integer. Allowed syntax: integer literals, x, +, -, *, parentheses, comparisons, and If(condition, then_value, else_value). Do not use division, functions other than If, prose, or Markdown.

name: Maximum of x, 2x, and 6
prompt: Return exactly one expression in integer variable x that computes the largest of x, 2*x, and 6 for every integer. Allowed syntax: integer literals, x, +, -, *, parentheses, comparisons, and nested If(condition, then_value, else_value). Do not use division, other functions, prose, or Markdown.

name: Integer sign function
prompt: Return exactly one expression in integer variable x that returns -1 when x is negative, 0 when x is zero, and 1 when x is positive. Allowed syntax: integer literals, x, +, -, *, parentheses, comparisons, and nested If(condition, then_value, else_value). Do not use division, other functions, prose, or Markdown.

name: Clamp an integer into [0, 10]
prompt: Return exactly one expression in integer variable x that returns 0 when x < 0, returns 10 when x > 10, and returns x otherwise. Allowed syntax: integer literals, x, +, -, *, parentheses, comparisons, and nested If(condition, then_value, else_value). Do not use division, other functions, prose, or Markdown.

name: Integer square
prompt: Return exactly one expression in integer variable x whose value is x squared for every integer. Allowed syntax: integer literals, x, +, -, *, parentheses, comparisons, and If(condition, then_value, else_value). Do not use division, exponentiation, other functions, prose, or Markdown.

name: Absolute value checked property by property
prompt: Return exactly one expression in integer variable x that computes the absolute value of x. It must satisfy all of these properties for every integer x: the result is non-negative, the result is at least x, and the result equals x or -x. Allowed syntax: integer literals, x, +, -, *, parentheses, comparisons, and If(condition, then_value, else_value). Do not use division, functions other than If, prose, or Markdown.

name: Dafny absolute value method body
prompt: Return only the Dafny statements for the body of method Abs. The fixed method receives x:int, returns y:int, and requires y >= 0 and (y == x || y == -x). Do not return method declarations, braces, Markdown, assume, axioms, externs, or explanations.

name: Dafny proof that factorial is positive
prompt: Return only the Dafny statements for the body of lemma FactorialPositive(n:nat), whose fixed postcondition is Factorial(n) > 0. Factorial is already defined. Do not return the lemma declaration, braces, Markdown, assume, axioms, externs, or explanations.

name: Dafny two-hole proof sketch
prompt: Produce a main lemma MainProof and two helper lemmas HelperA and HelperB, each taking n:nat and ensuring n >= 0. The fixed RequiredGoal calls MainProof. MainProof should call both helpers. Return only the Dafny lemma declarations and bodies, using exactly HOLE_Main, HOLE_A and HOLE_B for the proof bodies.

name: Dafny nested proof sketch for a summation identity
prompt: Sum(n) is fixed as Sum(0) == 0 and Sum(n) == n + Sum(n - 1). Prove lemma MainProof(n: nat) ensures Sum(n) * 2 == n * (n + 1). The fixed RequiredGoal calls MainProof. Start by returning only the declaration of MainProof with HOLE_Main as its proof body. When you later fill a hole you may either give its complete proof body or decompose it: write the proof body first, then declare the helper lemmas it calls below it, using HOLE_<parent>_<suffix> for each new proof body.
